behavior: AC1: no live binding names mimo-v2.5, and the pool, chain, pi and opencode name mimo-v2.6-flash
verification: grep -n -E '(openai/|nan/|"|: *)mimo-v2\.5([^0-9.]|$)' .pr_agent.toml .github/workflows/pr-agent.yml harness/model-map.json harness/reviewer-pool.json harness/nan-quotas.json ai/pi/settings.json ai/opencode/opencode.jsonc; [ $? -eq 1 ] && bats tests/reviewer-pool.bats tests/opencode.bats

behavior: AC2: the workflow's declared model and fallbacks equal .pr_agent.toml's, and PR-Agent reads them from the preflight
verification: o=$(bats -f 'chain the preflight probes|model travels in the workflow env' tests/pr-agent-config.bats) && printf '%s\n' "$o" | grep -c '^ok ' | grep -qx 3

behavior: AC3: the preflight skips a non-2xx or hanging model, fails when none answers, and never leaves the declared chain
verification:
bats tests/pr-agent-model-preflight.bats && o=$(bats -f 'preflight and the draw run wherever PR-Agent runs' tests/pr-agent-config.bats) && printf '%s
' "$o" | grep -q '^ok '

behavior: AC4: model-map declares per-model concurrency and the per-key cap at NaN's published base-plan figures, and the loader validates the shape
verification: o=$(cd cli && go test ./internal/harness -run 'TestModelMap(BudgetIsDeclarationOnly|SchemaAcceptsPerModelConcurrency|SchemaRejectsMalformedPerModelConcurrency)$' -count=1 -v) && printf '%s\n' "$o" | grep -c '^--- PASS: TestModelMap' | grep -qx 3 && o=$(bats -f 'published concurrency, per model and per key' tests/model-map.bats) && printf '%s\n' "$o" | grep -c '^ok ' | grep -qx 1

behavior: AC5: opencode and pi NaN windows and caps equal NaN's published figures, and enable_thinking appears nowhere
verification: o=$(bats -f 'published windows|effective reasoning_effort|README records' tests/opencode.bats) && printf '%s\n' "$o" | grep -c '^ok ' | grep -qx 3 && o=$(bats -f 'model overrides carry' tests/pi-config.bats) && printf '%s\n' "$o" | grep -c '^ok ' | grep -qx 1

behavior: AC6: PR-Agent streams its NaN calls, pinned by a test
verification:
o=$(bats tests/pr-agent-config.bats -f 'the NaN attempt streams its calls') && printf '%s
' "$o" | grep -q '^ok '

behavior: AC7: PR-Agent's total wait is below the job timeout, asserted by a test
verification:
o=$(bats tests/pr-agent-config.bats -f 'the job outlives both bounded Actions') && printf '%s
' "$o" | grep -q '^ok '

behavior: AC8: a daily canary probes every bound NaN model and reports the dead ones in one issue
verification: o=$(cd cli && go test ./internal/nanprobe/ -count=1 && go test ./internal/cmd/ -run 'HarnessCanary' -count=1 -v) && printf '%s\n' "$o" | grep -c '^--- PASS: TestHarnessCanary' | grep -qx 2 && bats tests/model-canary.bats

behavior: AC9: PR-Agent draws its first reviewer by declared weight from a pool of NaN models and Claude Haiku 5.5, routes a diff of 1,500 changed lines or more to Sonnet, and the other provider reviews when nothing was published
verification:
bats tests/pr-agent-route.bats tests/pr-agent-route-real.bats >/dev/null || exit 1; o=$(bats tests/pr-agent-config.bats -f 'second needs a measured absence|fail closed without invoking|routed model, allowlisted, with bounded input and output') && printf '%s
' "$o" | grep -c '^ok ' | grep -qx 3

behavior: AC10: reviews queue one at a time across the repository, and none is dropped
verification: bats tests/pr-agent-config.bats -f 'reviews queue one at a time' | grep -q '^ok 1 '
